name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating micro-enterprise ventures in rural and urban areas.
eligibilityCriteria: Any individual above 18 years. At least VIII pass for projects above Rs. 10 Lakhs in manufacturing or above Rs. 5 Lakhs in service sector. Only new projects are considered.
subsidyDetails: Up to 35% subsidy for rural areas (special category) and 25% for general category.
maxFunding: Up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for manufacturing sector and Rs. 20 Lakhs for service sector.
applicationSteps: Visit the official KVIC online portal.
Fill the online application form and upload documents.
Submit the application to the preferred bank.
Attend the EDP training once the loan is sanctioned.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu
description: Loans for starting a new micro-business or expanding a very small existing business without collateral.
eligibilityCriteria: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity.
subsidyDetails: No direct subsidy, but offers very low-interest rates. No collateral required.
applicationSteps: Visit a local bank or apply through the Udyamimitra portal.

name: Tamil Nadu Rural Transformation Project (TNRTP)
description: Exclusive scheme for rural entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu to promote rural enterprises, access to finance, and employment opportunities.
eligibilityCriteria: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu operating in targeted rural districts. Special focus on women and marginalized communities.
subsidyDetails: Provides matching grants up to 30% for business plans approved by the Village Poverty Reduction Committee.
maxFunding: Matching grant up to Rs. 3 Lakhs.
requiredDocuments: Business Plan approved by local VPRC
applicationSteps: Contact the local Village Poverty Reduction Committee (VPRC).
Submit your business plan for evaluation.
Receive matching grant upon bank loan approval.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana
description: State-specific scheme for youth in Uttar Pradesh to establish self-employment ventures.
eligibilityCriteria: Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh, aged 18-40 years, with minimum High School passing certificate.
subsidyDetails: Margin money subsidy of 25% on the project cost.
maxFunding: Up to Rs. 25 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs. 10 Lakhs for service sector.
applicationSteps: Apply online through the Di-UP portal.
Submit hard copies to the District Industries Centre (DIC).

name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra state scheme to create employment opportunities for youth by setting up micro-enterprises.
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Maharashtra, aged 18-45 years (relaxable for special categories). Minimum 7th pass.
subsidyDetails: State subsidy of 15% to 35% depending on category and location (rural/urban).
maxFunding: Up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs. 10 Lakhs for services.
applicationSteps: Submit application and project report online.
Clear the District Level Task Force (DLTF) interview.
